  SUBJECT : CSE 2152 - DATA STRUCTURES AND APPLICATIONS

Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Solve the problem of sorting one-dimensional array using a C program. Write a C  
  program that reads integers from the keyboard and places them in an array. The program  
  then sorts the array into ascending and descending order and prints the sorted lists. The (4)  
  program must not change the original array or create any other integer arrays.  
  [Hint: Use array of pointers]  
  
1B)          Solve the computation of XY using C program which uses recursive function.               (3)  
  
1C)          One of the important applications that can be implemented using queues is priority job  
  scheduling. Solve the problem of priority job scheduling using a priority queue in which  
  the empty position in the queue (created when the job is removed based on the priority) (3)  
  is indicated by a 'special indicator' so that a new job can be placed in the first empty  
  position.
